concerns.text: Task T008 permits a design‑aware analysis that may run a Repeated‑Measures ANOVA when participant IDs match, but the feature specification (FR‑007/FR‑008) mandates that the system always perform a Between‑Subjects analysis and only report the design type. This conflict makes the task potentially unexecutable under the current spec.

Task T016 specifies manual review as the verification method for the methods & results handoff document, without providing an automated test or script. Lack of an automated verification step means the task’s completion cannot be deterministically confirmed, violating the executability requirement.
